name: cut
description: Let Claude edit your talking-head video. Measures the free zone above the speaker, gets word-level timestamps from Deepgram, cuts frame-exact hook versions with ffmpeg, builds a word-synced animation zone with Remotion, and renders finished MP4s.

interface.shortDescription: Let Claude edit your talking-head video.
interface.longDescription: cut adds a skill that edits a vertical talking-head video end to end: it measures how much room there is above the speaker, gets word-level timestamps so every scene change sits on a word that was actually spoken, cuts frame-exact versions of each hook, builds the animation zone as a Remotion project, and renders finished MP4s with a contact sheet to check them.
defaultPrompt: /cut ~/Movies/take.mp4 I shot three hooks back to back, make three versions
/cut take.mp4 put graphics over the top, no subtitles burned in
